EC1: - intention to quit smoking in the next 30 days
EC2: - currently using pharmacotherapy for smoking cessation
EC3: - currently using electronic cigarettes more than 2 days/week
EC4: - unstable medical [OR] or psychiatric condition (defined as hospitalization)
EC5: - medical contraindications to nicotine (unstable angina, uncontrolled hypertension, [OR] or recent cardiovascular event, including hospitalization)
EC7: - substance use disorder other than nicotine dependence
EC8: - past-month suicidal ideation [OR] or past-year suicide attempt
